context: area: terminal content authoring and durable session content
area: broadcast coordination, shared navigation, and terminal runtime lifecycle
constraint: one game-master approval per forward or back transition
constraint: retain solved hacking state within the current broadcast
BUG-006 implementation used explicit feature directory specs/010-terminal-navigation because .specify/feature.json still points to feature 003 and bugfix-switch correctly refused a dirty worktree.
intent: Allow player-requested, game-master-approved movement between linked terminals with reversible navigation and preserved solved hacking state.
expectations: No persisted route history across application restarts or new broadcasts.
approach: Persist only an optional same-session terminal target on authored commands while keeping route, pending decisions, and hacking checkpoints in the coordinator's broadcast-scoped runtime. Reuse PlayerService.Navigate for forward and root-return requests, resolve every target again from the current validated session at approval, and publish the resulting active terminal and route in one revisioned stream update.

decisions.decision: Store an optional terminalTransition.targetTerminalId on command nodes in session JSON version 1
decisions.why: Stable IDs survive renames and an additive optional field preserves legacy documents and unknown-field round trips
decisions.rejected: A session-level link table, target names, or a new JSON version

decisions.decision: Make terminalTransition mutually exclusive with stateChange and validate references in two passes
decisions.why: The modes require different approval semantics and valid forward references must not depend on terminal array order
decisions.rejected: Implicit precedence between configs or single-pass validation

decisions.decision: Use a dedicated PendingTerminalNavigation approve/reject lifecycle
decisions.why: Player transitions must block shared actions and preserve the source checkpoint with one master decision
decisions.rejected: Reusing PendingTerminalSwitch or PendingCommandExecution

decisions.decision: Reuse NavigateCommand for forward transitions and NavigateBack at root for returns
decisions.why: Existing unary authorization, replay, revision, and acknowledgement semantics already cover both requests without trusting a browser-supplied target
decisions.rejected: A new public RPC or target ID in player requests

decisions.decision: Store a broadcast-scoped LIFO route with stable folder IDs and ancestor IDs
decisions.why: Stable identity supports rename and move while saved ancestors provide deterministic nearest-parent fallback after deletion
decisions.rejected: A raw old path, command ID alone, or a static terminal graph

decisions.decision: Resolve source and target again through a trusted current-session catalog at approval
decisions.why: Deleted or retargeted commands must fail safely instead of activating a frozen stale payload
decisions.rejected: Trusting frontend payloads or retaining an unvalidated target snapshot

decisions.decision: Reuse per-terminal runtime checkpoints but place navigation explicitly on activation
decisions.why: Existing checkpoints already retain solved, unfinished, and failed hacking state while the feature requires destination root and restored return-folder semantics
decisions.rejected: Persisting hack state or recreating terminal runtimes on every visit

decisions.decision: Expose only route depth, top return target, and secret-free pending state publicly
decisions.why: Players can render and reconnect consistently without receiving decision authority or the full private route
decisions.rejected: Client-local route state or publishing master request metadata

decisions.decision: Run a full idempotent player render after every matching shared-action result
decisions.why: When the authoritative stream arrives first, the complete surface was rendered while the button was disabled; the later unary result must recompute control properties as well as player context
decisions.rejected: Only removing the CSS pending class or relying on stream/unary arrival order

decisions.decision: Classify bundled demo commands by stateChange versus terminalTransition in browser assertions
decisions.why: Transition commands are valid ordinary command nodes whose text may be empty and which must not carry stateChange
decisions.rejected: Requiring every bundled command to satisfy state-change fields

decisions.decision: Reset fixture hack RNG at the terminal-navigation reset boundary
decisions.why: Each Playwright case must receive the same deterministic puzzle regardless of earlier suites in the shared fixture process
decisions.rejected: Assuming the first visible word is always an incorrect password without resetting fixture state

decisions.decision: Snapshot the complete portable session synchronously in desktopAPI before invoking Wails SaveSession
decisions.why: Prevents later UI or event mutations from changing the target terminal set for an accepted revision
decisions.rejected: Weakening domain validation or trusting stale or missing terminal targets

decisions.decision: Validate live terminal payloads against the complete active session and use the private protobuf adapter only for tree shape routing
decisions.why: Cross-terminal references are document-wide; synthetic one-terminal projections falsely reject valid links
decisions.rejected: Weakening domain.ValidateSession or stripping terminalTransition from native payloads

decisions.decision: Render only direct terminal-navigation pending through the existing record-description surface while keeping TerminalNavigationPresentation separate from CommandExecutionPresentation
decisions.why: Meets FR-029/SC-010 without merging independent protocol lifecycles or introducing an optimistic terminal switch
decisions.rejected: Reuse command-execution state or keep the transition-specific notice overlay

decisions.decision: Render every terminal-navigation pending direction through one full-screen record-description surface and suppress notices until the master resolves it
decisions.why: Forward and return requests share the same authoritative waiting contract and input lock while retaining separate navigation and command-execution protocols
decisions.rejected: Keep a return-specific overlay over the current terminal screen

decisions.decision: Normalize Wails file filter globs to bare extensions on Darwin while preserving documented glob syntax on other platforms
decisions.why: Wails v3 beta passes Darwin patterns to UTType as filename extensions, so '*.json' disables the native Open action while 'json' works
decisions.rejected: Relax the session chooser filter or special-case only one dialog

decisions.decision: Name the shared protobuf oneof behavior and keep ordinary commands unset
decisions.why: One generated discriminant makes state_change and terminal_transition structurally exclusive while preserving field numbers 2 and 3 and JSON names
decisions.rejected: Two independent proto3 optional fields with validation-only mutual exclusion

decisions.decision: Keep JSON-v1 command config pointers and expose a domain Behavior discriminant
decisions.why: The decoder must retain malformed dual-config documents long enough to reject them defensively without changing the durable JSON version or known names
decisions.rejected: An interface-only domain union that would silently discard or complicate legacy JSON input

decisions.decision: Use one three-option master command mode selector and delete inactive configs on apply
decisions.why: The UI can represent only ordinary, state-change, or terminal-transition and save/reopen restores exactly one choice
decisions.rejected: Two checkboxes with JavaScript mutual exclusion

decisions.decision: Every valid player-selected command enters one server-authoritative master approval lifecycle; authored mode controls only the approved effect.
decisions.why: BUG-005 requires approval to be behavior-independent while retaining ordinary, state-change, completed-state-change, and transition semantics.
decisions.rejected: Preserving the ordinary/completed fast paths that bypass master approval.

decisions.decision: Provide deterministic Left/Right keyboard focus movement between Approve and Reject in private command and terminal-navigation dialogs.
decisions.why: The signed Wails WebView does not expose dialog buttons in the macOS accessibility tree; the keyboard seam makes explicit reject independently operable and testable while preserving button behavior.
decisions.rejected: Relying on inaccessible AX descendants or coordinate-only clicks.

decisions.decision: Assert the state-changing master dialog against the pending request ID returned by the fixture state endpoint.
decisions.why: The dialog must prove the exact server-authoritative request identity, mode, and command name across every lifecycle journey.
decisions.rejected: A fixed legacy string or request-ID pattern would not prove identity convergence.

decisions.decision: Approve CRT ordinary commands through a fixture-only endpoint that resolves the current private pending request.
decisions.why: This exercises the real universal approval boundary while keeping production behavior and protobuf contracts unchanged.
decisions.rejected: Bypassing approval or changing the command to a state-changing mode would invalidate the acceptance coverage.

decisions.decision: Leave implementation sources unchanged during this rerun.
decisions.why: All 46 tasks are complete, the all-bugfix consistency verification passed, and no executable task remains.
decisions.rejected: Reopening completed tasks or rerunning implementation work without a specification gap.

decisions.decision: Retain CommandExecutionPhaseRejected for ordinary and initial state-change rejects, while completed-state-change and terminal-navigation rejection semantics remain unchanged.
decisions.why: The existing player renderer, public adapter, reconnect projection, and Back/Enter acknowledgement already implement the required access-error lifecycle once the coordinator publishes REJECTED.
decisions.rejected: Adding notification-specific or client-local rejection state.

decisions.decision: Publish forward terminal-navigation rejection through the existing detached CommandExecutionPresentation REJECTED state.
decisions.why: The player renderer, stream adapter, reconnect snapshot, and Back/Enter acknowledgement already implement the required access-error lifecycle.
decisions.rejected: Adding new protobuf fields or a second terminal-navigation rejection presentation.
